text:
Priya (AE): Hey team — Rivermark POC kicking off today. Ran into access blockers: their Okta team says SCIM create returns 409 on groups and SAML login fails with 'Audience mismatch'. Need quick preflight to get hosted API key + dedicated pool trial ready. Anyone available?
Mateo (SE): I can jump in. Can you paste the SAML assertion error + the SCIM payload that 409s? Also do we need Dedicated for throughput or just Hosted for POC?
Priya (AE): They need ~600 req/min during peak tests so we proposed a 1-node dedicated pool trial. Pricing-wise we quoted the standard POC rate, but finance asked for written ack about potential overage. I'll handle that. Here's the SAML error they pasted:
```
SAMLResponse error: AudienceRestriction failed
Expected: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs
Got: https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs
```
Priya (AE): And SCIM failing (excerpt):
```
POST /scim/v2/Groups -> 409 Conflict
{"detail":"Group with displayName 'eng-core' already exists for tenant 'rivermark' (externalId collision)"}
```
Evan (SRE): Audience mismatch looks like metadata we provided vs what their IdP has. Could be trailing slash or prod vs app hostname. Check the ACS and EntityID in our SAML metadata. Also verify cert chain — their Okta logs show `Signature invalid` sometimes when cert rotated.
Mateo (SE): On SCIM 409 — sounds like multitenant attr collision: their orgs share displayName across subtenants and our SCIM uses displayName as uniqueness fallback. We can adjust to prefer `externalId` if provided. Can they send `externalId` or `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:enterprise:2.0:Group:externalId`? If not, we can patch the SCIM handler to include tenant scoping in the unique check for the POC env.
Dana (PM): For the Dedicated trial: infra can stand up a 1xA10g for a week. Need legal to ok a short-term commit. I flagged finance — Priya please confirm they accept the POC usage cap.
Lisa (Security): From SEC questionnaire: they want confirmation SCIM provisioning only has Group create/update scope, no user delete. We currently allow full CRUD with service account. For POC we can scope SCIM token to `groups:rw users:r` — would that satisfy?
Priya (AE): Yes they agreed to restricted scope. I'll ask their IdP team to add `externalId` and align EntityID. I also asked them to try a test SAML login with the ACS value set to `https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs` and paste the raw SAMLResponse if it still fails.
Mateo (SE): Quick remediation steps:
1) Priya — get their IdP metadata URL + sample SAMLResponse
2) Evan — I'll need the SAML metadata to verify EntityID and cert thumbprint
3) I can push a SCIM POC-patch to treat displayName non-unique when tenant_id present; that'll avoid 409s. Will deploy to the POC env (non-prod) if SRE ok.
Evan (SRE): Ok to deploy to the POC cluster. I'll also whitelist their test IP range for Private/VPC demo. Send me CIDR.
Priya (AE): They already sent CIDR: 203.0.113.0/24. Also asked re: Hosted API key vs Dedicated: they want data isolation — so Dedicated or Private. For demo we'll do Dedicated trial and show Private options later.
Mateo (SE): FYI to avoid future collisions, recommend using SCIM `externalId` populated with a canonical UUID concatenated with tenant slug. I'll add that to our onboarding checklist.
Priya (AE): Timeline: if IdP metadata + CIDR + externalId ok today, SE and SRE can have POC running by EOD. I'll coordinate legal/finance for POC rate ack.
Lisa (Security): Also confirm logs retention for POC (14 days ok?) and that service account keys are rotated after the trial.
Priya (AE): 14 days accepted. We'll rotate keys post-trial. Thanks all — tagging next steps:
@Mateo (SE) deploy SCIM tenant-scope patch
@Evan (SRE) whitelist 203.0.113.0/24 and verify SAML metadata
@Dana (PM) confirm infra slot and cost note
I'll follow up with the Rivermark IdP team once we have the metadata.
Mateo (SE): On it. :thumbsup:
Evan (SRE): Doing the whitelist now.
Dana (PM): Reserved the node — expect deployment window 16:30 PST.
Priya (AE): Great. Closing loop when done. Thanks :rocket:
